name: PCI DSS
source: PCI DSS v4.0 (PCI Security Standards Council, March 2022), https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org/documents/PCI-DSS-v4_0.pdf (live URL is gated behind the PCI SSC document agreement; retrieved from the Internet Archive capture of that official URL, timestamp 20220404115505, https://web.archive.org/web/20220404115505id_/https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org/documents/PCI-DSS-v4_0.pdf)
notes: Top-level requirements only (the 12 numbered requirements), not the ~300 sub-requirements. Titles extracted verbatim from the 'Requirement N:' section headings in the official v4.0 PDF. PCI DSS v4.0 was superseded by v4.0.1 (June 2024); this file is deliberately the v4.0 edition requested. Do not confuse the 12 requirements with the 6 'goals' or the sub-requirement numbering (e.g. 6.4.3). This list is flat: each requirement is its own group, so group_title repeats the requirement title.
cross_check: The 12 'Requirement N:' headings of the official v4.0 PDF, one for each number 1..12, with requirement 4's wrapped heading rejoined.

group_reasons.9: physical access controls (facility entry, visitor management, media handling and point-of-interaction tamper protection): there is no network-observable artefact, and ARACHNE ships no physical or host-agent check

default_reason: no shipped ARACHNE check produces evidence about this control
